units.source_text: 他以前曾经热爱这五节小姐，现在收到她的信，觉得这个人越发可爱了。

en.t: He had once loved this Lady of the Gosechi deeply, and now, receiving her letter, he felt that she was all the more dear to him.

units.source_text: 然而此时他已经规行矩步，恭谨处世，不再有浪漫的举动了。

en.t: Yet by this time he had become proper and restrained, conducting himself with caution and respect, and he no longer made any romantic gestures.

units.source_text: 对于花散里等，也只致信问候，并不去访。

en.t: As for Hanachirusato and the others, he merely sent letters of greeting and did not go to visit them.

units.source_text: 她们只收到信，反而增添了怨恨。

en.t: Since they received only letters, their resentment only grew stronger.
